key_points.verbatim: The rapid integration of agentic AI into high-stakes real-world applications requires robust oversight mechanisms. The emerging field of AI Control (AIC) aims to provide such an oversight mechanism, but practical adoption depends heavily on implementation overhead.

key_points.point: The document supports the use of advanced AI models as monitors to defend against malicious AI-generated code. By leveraging high-performing models for automated oversight, practitioners can create a robust defense-in-depth strategy. This approach aligns with accelerationist goals of using AI capabilities to solve security challenges, provided the monitoring costs are managed effectively.
